title: Status Effect Fix
description: Make status effect levels higher than 9 show up in the inventory!
body:
## 📕 Status Effect Fix
Makes it so you can see the level of every status effect in the inventory screen, not just up to level 9!

[![ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/H2H118OP6T)

## Usage
Since version 1.0.2, Better Levels is embedded, so you don't need it. 

Before version 1.0.2, you need the Better Levels resource pack in addition to the mod.

## Showcase
![A showcase of the mod with the Better Levels resource pack applied.](https://github.com/Sheepearrrrrrrrrr/Sheepearrrrrrrrrr.github.io/blob/main/about/effectfix.png?raw=true)
